I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list in your DM:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers on the 04:00 shift at Eau Claire Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments from the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed the next shift went through fine.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea also logged this one: the Door 14 gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

Moss's other three notes have no Quarrendon ticket numbers. The ticket numbers in the Central handoffs note (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to other accounts. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways", which is a different company and not a customer.

The knowledge brain refused access, so I couldn't search it. This list only covers the shared files and the #general and #help-it-ops channels, which had no messages.
